summary: Test suite has reasonable functional coverage of the matrix generation logic (cartesian, exclude, include rules) and exercises the workflow through act, but has critical gaps: (1) Shell validation tests (shellcheck, bash -n) are explicitly required but completely absent. (2) Tests violate the stated requirement 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' — test/generate-matrix.bats runs the script directly, not through the pipeline. (3) Workflow.bats uses brittle fixed-string grepping (e.g., 'MATRIX_RESULT fixture=basic...') instead of robust JSON parsing. (4) Some edge cases missing: scalar dimension coercion isn't tested, very large matrices, Unicode handling. (5) Fixture files referenced but not shown, so fixture quality/comprehensiveness is unverifiable. (6) Python dependency for YAML parsing is reasonable but adds complexity. Strengths: Good separation of concerns (unit, structure, e2e); efficient single act run covering all fixtures via matrix; clear test naming; proper use of bats helpers.
